//==
// # IGeometry point queries
//
// What a geometric entity answers about a GIVEN POINT: point membership, the point
// of itself nearest a query, and — for convex shapes — the support mapping that
// GJK-style collision queries are built on.

// Supports a point-membership test in the plane. For closed shapes the boundary
// counts as inside. (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Point_in_polygon)
interface IContainsPoint2D
{
    Contains(x: Self, point: Point2D): Boolean;
}
